# Propvale — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib "Real Estate 2" (slug: real-estate-2)

## Preview Analysis

The preview at `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/realestate2/` was unreachable
during implementation. Design is based on the TEMPLATES.md screenshot and
the ColorLib page description.

## Color Palette

- **Primary:** Orange gradient `#FDAE5C` → `#fd8e5e` (buttons, accents, CTA)
- **Dark Navy:** `#001D38` (top bar, hero overlay, counter section)
- **Navy Light:** `#10273C` (footer)
- **Body:** `#26282b`
- **Light sections:** `#f4f7f9`
- **White:** `#ffffff`

## Typography

- **Display/Headings:** Poppins (400,500,600,700)
- **Body:** Roboto (400,500,700)

## Layout

- Full-width hero with dark overlay and centered search form
- 3-column property card grid (6 cards total)
- Accordion FAQ section
- 3-column stats counter on dark bg
- Testimonial carousel
- 4-column agent grid
- Full-width CTA with orange gradient
- 4-column footer

## Placeholder Images

All images use `picsum.photos/seed/propvale-N/W/H` for deterministic placeholders.
